wins.text: Q3 net revenues of $15.2B, EPS of $12.25, ROE of 14.2% and ROTE of 15.2%; YTD ROTE of 15.6%
Advisory revenues of $1.4B, up 60% YoY on record M&A completions; GS advised on over $1 trillion in announced M&A YTD, $220B ahead of nearest competitor
Record alternatives fundraising of $33B in Q3, bringing YTD to $70B; full-year guidance raised to ~$100B vs. prior expectations
AWM management and other fees rose 12% YoY to a record $2.9B; combined durable revenues (mgmt fees + private banking/lending) hit record $4B in Q3 and $11B YTD
Returned $3.3B to shareholders in Q3 including $2B in buybacks and $1.3B in dividends; CET1 ratio of 14.4% vs. 10.9% requirement

risks.text: Equities intermediation revenues fell 9% YoY driven by weaker cash equities performance against difficult prior-year comps (prior year period up ~30%)
Non-comp expenses rose 14% YoY to $4.8B driven by higher transaction costs, charitable giving and litigation expenses, pressuring efficiency ratio
Provision for credit losses of $339M primarily from net charge-offs in credit card portfolio; Apple Card exit timeline remains unresolved
Management flagged potential for market cycle turn: 'investor exuberance' with equity markets at record highs and AI infrastructure investment creating risk of divergence where some ventures falter
AWM incentive fees tracking well below $1B medium-term target; unrealized balance of $4.6B dependent on deal monetization environment to pull through P&L

guidance_items.detail: Full-year alternatives fundraising guidance raised to ~$100B, substantially exceeding prior full-year expectations; prior run-rate was ~$65B/year
AWM durable revenues (mgmt fees + private banking/lending) expected to grow high single digits annually over medium term, unchanged
Full-year effective tax rate expected at approximately 22%, unchanged
YTD comp ratio of 32.5% represents best estimate for full year, inclusive of higher severance costs

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Synthetic risk transfer (SRT) activity and what credit exposures are being moved off balance sheet
Specific risks from lending to non-bank financial institutions (NDFIs) and private credit counterparties including named troubled credits (First Brands, Tricolor)
Timeline and specific quantitative metrics for measuring One Goldman Sachs 3.0 success
